The transmission inner function changes its flow expression from `var.loc[:, idx] * efficiency[idx]` to `var.loc[:, idx] * -efficiency.sel(name=idx)`. For a branch with nonzero flow and nonzero port efficiency, this reverses the sign of the reported weighted transmission value, even under legacy semantics with the default, `"auto"`, or `"multiindex"` snapshot option.
